meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会把你的设计对照迪特·拉姆斯十项原则逐条审查,每项打0–3分并列出证据,然后给出新设计、精炼或重新设计的结论,最后生成一份可直接交给/make-plan的提示词。全程不写代码。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”、“设计评审”、“检查这个UI是否符合Rams原则”等,或要求进行会导向计划的设计批评时触发。

say.text: 审计这个设计的十项拉姆斯原则,给出分数和证据。
按迪特·拉姆斯原则评审这个界面,并给出改进计划。
检查这个UI是否好用,对照十原则打分。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude audits your design against Dieter Rams' 10 principles, scores each 0–3 with evidence, gives a verdict (new/refine/redesign), and outputs a /make-plan prompt. No code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'audit this design', 'design review', 'check this UI against Rams', etc., or ask for a critique that leads to a plan.

say_en.text: Audit this design against the ten principles and give scores with evidence.
Review this UI against Dieter Rams' principles and suggest improvements.
say_en.note: Produces a verdict and handoff prompt.

say_en.text: Check if this UI is good, scoring it on the ten principles.
say_en.note: Outputs a handoff prompt after audit.
